scope: Fresh process, instrumented startup and CPU content paint; no presentation measurement. Three settled samples, no forced GC. OS lifetime peaks are separate from observed samples. Data-only control never loads the native library. Library-only control loads it through a runtime probe but creates no host. Inspect round trips include scheduling, serialization and diagnostic work; not pure transport or input latency.
